items.item_text: CPMSM or CPCS preferred or completing track for certification
Associate Degree in Medical Staff Services Management or equivalent courses, training, and experience
3-5 years minimum experience in Medical Staff Services
Experience in CACTUS software or equal credentialing program

Using the assistance of the Credentials Coordinator, initiates, analyzes, administers, verifies, compiles, manages, and maintains confidential research required for credentialing of initial appointees and for continuous credentialing/reappointment for members of assigned department(s).

Oversees and maintains documentation for continuous credentialing purposes. Communicates appropriate information to internal and external customers- including answering outside requests for activity and affiliation requests.

Maintains current records of proctoring for all provisional physicians as well as those physicians seeking new privileges. Assures appropriate review of proctoring reports. Explains proctoring information to new physicians. Communicates proctoring status to appropriate hospital departments such as nursing, surgery, OB, ICU, ER, etc.
Completes work in a timely manner according to guidelines outlined in the Medical Staff Bylaws.
Attends meetings and provides guidance, resources and support to Medical Staff officers, committee and department chairpersons. Develops agenda, consults with department chairpersons and officers.

Prepares and maintains accurate and timely documentation of Medical Staff management and peer review monitoring activities following legal guidelines, TJC and other federal and state requirements. Assures timely follow up action is taken.
